text:
𝗘𝗥𝗔𝗦𝗠𝗨𝗦 𝗦𝗛𝗢𝗪! 🇳🇦

Gerhard Erasmus smashes 156* off 125 as Namibia post 321/6, then takes 2/13 too 🔥

Jack Brassell's 4/52 bowls Ireland out for 290 — Namibia win by 31 runs 🏏

#Cricket #NAMvIRE

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗮𝗺𝗶𝗯𝗶𝗮 𝗻𝗲 𝗜𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗸𝗼 𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗮! 🇳🇦🔥

ODI mein Namibia ki 31 runs se shaandaar jeet 🏏

👉 Gerhard Erasmus – 125 balls mein 156* 💥 (14 chauke, 4 chhakke)
👉 Namibia ne banaye 321/6
👉 Bowling mein bhi Erasmus ke 2 wicket
👉 Jack Brassell ke 4 wicket, Ireland 290 par all out

Chhoti team, bada kamaal! Aapko ye upset kaisa laga? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #Cricket #NAMvIRE
